title: Quant calibration replay: hash-indexed artifact playbook and audit hooks
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a practical playbook, CI checks, and index format for fully replayable quantization artifacts used in FP8/INT8 calibration. This ticket defines the hash-indexed artifact catalog, immutable manifest layout, signature/checksum rules, CI gating for accuracy regressions, and an operational rollback checklist that can be executed by SREs and MLEs. Goal: ensure every quantized model build can be reproduced bit-for-bit from source calibration inputs and toolchain metadata, and that rollbacks and audits are fast and automated.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff notes: scoped to calibration artifacts (calibration traces, scale/zero-point tables, quant params, toolchain version, seed/state). Decided base hash = SHA-256 over canonicalized tarball with deterministic ordering. Need to define canonicalization rules for numpy arrays and protobufs.

2026-03-07 - Liam Chen: Prototype of index format pushed in GH: uses CSV index with columns [artifact_hash, artifact_type, model_id, calib_dataset_hash, toolchain_version, created_by, created_at, signature]. Draft PR: #842. Initial tests show deterministic tar ordering + normalized float repr is sufficient for our PyTorch->ONNX->quant flow.

2026-03-09 - Sofia Patel (PM): Requested that manifests also include 'accuracy_signature' field: lightweight accuracy fingerprint computed from fixed eval prompts (JSONL) and quantized outputs to detect silent regressions without full eval. Trade-off: more storage but faster triage.

2026-03-10 - Security review (initial): Key management notes: sign manifests with HSM-backed key; store signatures in KMS-backed metadata store. Security team requested threat model for swapped artifacts; added to playbook.

2026-03-11 - Eng: Added CI gate design: PRs that change calibration tooling must produce reproducible artifact for a small golden model and pass accuracy_delta <= 0.002 on goldenset. CI will run 'replay-and-compare' job that fetches previous artifact by hash and runs byte-level diff plus accuracy signature compare.

2026-03-12 - Design feedback from Maya Rivera: Recommend human-readable manifest v1 (TOML) plus compact binary index for fast lookups. Also propose UI columns in Console: artifact hash, accuracy_signature, baseline_delta, rollout_status. Filed DES-412 for Console column mockups.

2026-03-13 - Liam Chen: Implemented replay runner that replays calibration traces with frozen RNG seed and toolchain container. Found one source of nondeterminism: timestamp metadata embedded in numpy.save. Fixed by normalizing timestamps and using numpy.savez with allow_pickle=False.

2026-03-14 - Ava Martinez: Plan for rollout: (1) land index + canonicalization helpers behind feature flag, (2) backfill current artifacts with computed hashes and signatures, (3) enable CI replay for calibration tool PRs, (4) expose audit endpoints in Console and add rollback playbook doc. Next: pair with SRE to test rollback runbook in staging.
2026-03-14 - QA note (Jamal Ortiz): Need test harness for cross-hardware reproducibility (A100 FP8 vs H100 FP8) — add matrix to CI. Created follow-up ENG-21028.
